items.title: European Central Bank keeps key interest rate on hold at 2.5%
items.summary: The European Central Bank voted to hold interest rates steady on Thursday, meeting market expectations, despite euro zone inflation rising to a three-year high.

items.title: Third-quarter U.S. GDP increases a better-than-expected 3.4% as September inflation accelerates
items.summary: The pace of price increases stepped up in September, keeping inflation well above the Federal Reserve's target, while the economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter, according to Commerce Department reports Thursday.

items.title: The politics of President Lagarde's European Central Bank early exit  — and who could replace her
items.summary: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde will step down on Feb. 7 next year, she announced Thursday, formally kicking off a succession race that will be shaped by political bargaining and France's looming fiscal crisis.

items.title: Analysis: Kevin Warsh is keeping Wall Street guessing. It may be his most powerful tool
items.summary: The Federal Reserve chairman's news conference Wednesday was sharply different from his early appearances in the job, when he often seemed backed into a corner.
